title: If a pit spheroidising furnace has water cooling, do I still need to supply the pump and tank?
summary: Seal cooling on the furnace does not mean that external water-supply equipment is included. Suneng's 2011 proposal for a steel-wire pit spheroidising annealing furnace describes dual water supplies for the lid and retort-mouth flanges, but the quotation explicitly assigns the external circulating pump and plastic water tank to the user. Define furnace cooling components, external water sources and backup-supply changeover conditions separately.
